title: Loli and the Little Bubble
dedication: For Loli, with love. Even the smallest kindness can shine.

pages.text:
In the garden, Loli dipped her wand.
A little breath…
a little puff…
Out came a bubble, round and bright.
It grew bigger than her boots.
Bigger than her head!
“Oh!” said Loli. “Hello, bubble.”
pages.illustration: The child in a yellow raincoat, teal striped top and blue boots blows a growing rainbow bubble beside garden flowers.

pages.text:
The big bubble scooped Loli up.
Up past the flowers.
Up past the tree.
A bird peeped into her floating window.
“Hello, bird!” Loli giggled.
The garden grew small below her.
Where would her bubble go?
pages.illustration: The same child in the same outfit floats inside a large rainbow bubble beside a small bird above the garden.

pages.text:
Beyond the clouds floated a whole bubble village.
Big bubbles bobbed.
Little bubbles bounced.
But one tiny bubble sat all alone.
Its colors were fading.
Its little mouth trembled.
Loli leaned closer.
“What’s wrong, little bubble?”
pages.illustration: The same child approaches a tiny round translucent bubble with two eyes and a trembling mouth among a village of floating bubbles.

pages.text:
“I’ve lost my sparkle,” whispered the bubble.
Loli reached out to catch it.
But the little bubble wobbled away.
“Too fast!” it squeaked.
Loli stopped. She rested her hands in her lap.
“I’ll go slowly,” she said.
pages.illustration: The same child rests both hands in their lap while the same pale round bubble friend wobbles just out of reach.

pages.text:
Loli held out one open hand.
This time, she waited.
The little bubble drifted closer…
closer…
and settled above her palm.
“Softly, softly,” whispered Loli.
She blew the gentlest puff.
A tiny pink sparkle blinked inside.
pages.illustration: The same child holds an open palm and gently blows toward the same tiny round bubble friend with one pink sparkle inside.

pages.text:
“Again?” asked the bubble.
Loli smiled.
“Softly, softly.”
Puff.
Pink became gold.
Gold became blue.
The little bubble gave a happy wiggle.
“My colors!” it cried.
Loli laughed—and the bubble laughed too.
pages.illustration: The same child laughs with the same round bubble friend, now glowing pink, gold and blue above their open palm.

pages.text:
Soon, bubbles were bobbing all around them.
“Thank you, Loli!”
Her little friend glowed brightest of all.
Then Loli gave a great big yawn.
The big bubble dipped down beside her.
“Home?” she asked.
Home they floated, softly, softly.
pages.illustration: The same child yawns inside the large descending bubble while the tiny round pink, gold and blue friend floats alongside.

pages.text:
Back in her room, Loli took off her boots.
One boot.
Two boots.
At the window, a tiny bubble twinkled pink, gold, and blue.
“Night-night, little friend,” Loli whispered.
She snuggled down.
Outside, her friend shone softly.
pages.illustration: The same child in teal striped pajamas snuggles in bed; yellow coat and blue boots are beside the bed and the same bubble friend glows at the window.
